name: NuClass TLS evidence profile
purpose: Traceable cell measurements and spatial evidence for expert review of lung-cancer lymphoid aggregates.
status: Research interpretation; no calibrated TLS-maturity, cell-identity or clinical-outcome score.

sources.title: Vanhersecke et al. · Standardized pathology screening of mature TLS · Laboratory Investigation, 2023
sources.evidence: A visible germinal centre or an appropriately identified CD23-positive follicular dendritic-cell network supports mature TLS in this screening framework. Its ≥50-immune-cell screening rule is study-specific. Review viable tissue and exclude ulceration, necrosis and residual lymphoid organs.
sources.application: Separate H&E review from B-cell and FDC immunostaining. Predicted DCs do not identify FDCs.

sources.title: Siliņa & Ciompi · Hitchhiker’s guide to cancer-associated lymphoid aggregates, 2024
sources.evidence: Combine low-power aggregate boundaries with high-power lymphocyte, stromal and germinal-centre morphology. Larger cells and a less densely packed region can support GC review. The guide cautions that human H&E appearance alone does not reliably distinguish B from T cells.
sources.application: Show linked scales, measured cell sizes and density; collect GC review without automatically assigning maturity.

sources.title: Germain et al. · B cells in TLS and protective immunity in lung cancer · AJRCCM, 2014
sources.evidence: NSCLC TLS contain organised B-cell follicles with T cells and mature dendritic cells, and their B-cell component was associated with protective immunity in the studied cohort.
sources.application: Measure composition together with organisation. An H&E-predicted B-cell cluster is a hypothesis requiring orthogonal validation.

sources.title: Siliņa et al. · Germinal centres determine TLS prognostic relevance in lung squamous cancer · Cancer Research, 2018
sources.evidence: Multispectral microscopy, quantitative pathology and expression profiling linked lung squamous TLS maturation and germinal-centre formation with biological and prognostic differences.
sources.application: Keep GC evidence distinct from aggregate count, size and B/T mixing. LUSC results are not automatic validation in these LUAD examples.

sources.title: Cho et al. · Pan-Cancer Spatial Atlas of TLS · Science, 2026
sources.evidence: Spatial transcriptomics and orthogonal protein profiling connect TLS organisation with stromal and immune niches. HookNet detection and two-stage YOLO classification already address H&E TLS maturity; the reported 94.7% accuracy is conditional P-versus-S subclassification in its external TLS set.
sources.application: Compare explicit cell-and-niche measurements, rather than claiming a new first TLS detector. This paper’s mature/P/S terminology differs from the binary CD23-based framework.

sources.title: MorphLink · Interpretable morphology–molecular spatial associations · Nature Communications, 2025
sources.evidence: Interpretable image descriptors can be connected with molecular spatial patterns. A spatial association does not by itself identify the visual features used by an existing classifier.
sources.application: Link contours to measurable phenotypes, spatial context and frozen-model decisions; keep association, surrogate fidelity and intervention evidence distinct.

sources.title: Wu et al. · ROSIE · Nature Communications, 2025
sources.evidence: Paired H&E and multiplex fluorescence support protein and cell-phenotype inference. Nuclear morphology plus H&E colour is an explicit baseline, and lymphocyte subtype identification remains more difficult than reading a simple shape descriptor.
sources.application: Include nuclei-only and colour baselines; never present a high nuclear-to-cell ratio as proof that a cell is B rather than T.

sources.title: HistoCell · Systematic inference of super-resolution cell spatial profiles · Nature Communications, 2025
sources.evidence: Spatial-omics supervision connects histological single-nucleus features with cell types, states and spatial networks.
sources.application: Analyse several lineages and neighbourhoods, while making the incremental contribution of measured whole-cell geometry testable.

sources.title: Schürch et al. · Coordinated cellular neighbourhoods · Cell, 2020
sources.evidence: Multiplex tissue imaging demonstrates that spatially coordinated cellular neighbourhoods add information beyond isolated cell abundances in colorectal cancer.
sources.application: Use neighbourhood composition, adjacency and radial profiles as an analysis design. Do not transfer the CRC prognostic result to two lung slides.

sources.title: Carpenter et al. · CellProfiler quantitative cell phenotypes · Genome Biology, 2006
sources.evidence: Explicit cell and subcellular image measurements provide reproducible shape, intensity and texture descriptors.
sources.application: Report physical area, shape, optical-density and compartment features with formulas and units.

sources.title: VitaminP · Cross-modal whole-cell segmentation from routine histology, 2026 preprint
sources.evidence: Paired H&E and multiplex fluorescence transfer whole-cell boundary information to H&E-only inference. Inferred cell boundaries remain predictions, not measured membranes in a new H&E specimen.
sources.application: Identify the v6 VitaminP-derived geometry and its checkpoint; show nuclear and whole-cell contours and retain failed or uncertain instances.

criteria.label: B-cell / follicular organisation
criteria.available: Predicted B/T spatial evidence; CD20 not measured

criteria.label: Visible germinal centre with mantle / blast morphology
criteria.available: Expert H&E review; not automatically labelled

criteria.label: FDC network supported by CD21 / CD23
Specialised HEV supported by appropriate staining
criteria.available: Unavailable; ordinary endothelial calls are insufficient

criteria.label: Viable, interpretable tissue; no necrosis / ulceration artifact
Intra-, peri- or distal-tumoral location
criteria.available: Requires a reviewed tumour boundary; combined epithelial class is insufficient

criteria.label: Ectopic tissue context; exclude residual lymph node / normal lymphoid organ

metrics.label: Lymphoid density
metrics.formula: (N_T + N_B) / candidate mask area in mm²
metrics.direction: Higher means denser predicted lymphoid infiltration, not confirmed TLS.

metrics.label: Lymphoid fraction · 0–100
metrics.direction: Cell-composition component; candidate selection used related CellSTP evidence.

metrics.label: B/T zoning · 0–100
metrics.formula: 100 × max(0, 1 − f_cross / [2 N_B N_T / (N(N−1))]); f_cross is the fraction of undirected 6-nearest-neighbour edges ≤50µm joining B and T.
metrics.direction: Higher indicates a deficit of cross-type edges relative to a composition-conditioned random-label expectation. Not a maturity score.

metrics.label: B-core contrast · 0–100
metrics.formula: 100 × max(0, B/(B+T) in the inner half of candidate pixels by distance-to-boundary − B/(B+T) in the outer half).
metrics.direction: Measures one specified core/rim pattern. A valid B follicle need not sit at the geometric centre.

metrics.label: Cell / nuclear / cytoplasmic area
metrics.formula: Raster pixel count × 0.425²; cytoplasm = whole-cell mask excluding associated nuclear pixels.
metrics.direction: Measured 2-D section area, not 3-D volume or a molecular state.

metrics.label: Nuclear-to-cell area ratio
metrics.formula: Associated nuclear pixel area / whole-cell pixel area; quantitative QC requires one contained nucleus and complete masks.
metrics.direction: A compartment measurement; does not alone prove B/T identity or proliferation.

metrics.label: Nuclear displacement
metrics.formula: Euclidean distance between whole-cell and nuclear centroids × 0.425.
metrics.direction: Tests eccentric nuclear geometry, for example within predicted plasma-cell populations; no automatic plasma diagnosis.

metrics.label: Measurement yield · 0–100
metrics.formula: 100 × unique linked original nuclei with complete, single-nucleus, contained whole-cell masks / all original candidate nuclei.
metrics.direction: Higher means more usable measurements. This is coverage/QC yield, not segmentation accuracy.

score_policy: Components remain separate; no sum is advertised as mature-TLS probability. Missing IHC and unreviewed anatomy stay unknown. Raw units, denominators, model provenance and QC accompany every score.
next_validation: Two independent pathology reviewers; H&E aggregate/GC annotations plus matched CD20/CD3, CD21/CD23 and, when relevant, PNAd and Ki-67. Evaluate agreement, detection, calibration and patient-level external transfer before fitting a clinical or maturity composite.
